core_claim: Recipient-specific sensory-site feedback improves aligned displacement over a population-marginal-matched yoke at stationary through 10-s reversal schedules, while the small contrast reverses at 5 s in this source-model simulation.
uncertainty: two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over 100 paired simulation seed blocks; 20,000 draws; seed 20261015 for primary condition
figure_legend: Self-contingent minus cross-agent-yoked environment-aligned displacement rate (model-distance units/s) across warm-gradient reversal schedules. Points show paired means across 100 simulation seed blocks; bars show two-sided 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals (20,000 draws). The dashed line marks zero; the 20-s schedule was the primary condition. This retrospective source-model simulation does not establish biological causation or artificial-system benefit. Source data are provided in figure_source_data.csv.
